items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I think Teo Macero (PHONETIC) was in the booth, you know, the producer

ctx.x: You know? And how they made -- but Duke was so smart in that -- I think Teo Macero (PHONETIC) was in the booth, you know, the producer, and they wanted to make it like a battle of jazz, but Duke didn't have it that way. When Thad Jones would take a solo, Duke would have his reed section play behind him. And when Ray Nance would play a solo, Duke would have Basie's reed section play behind him. So it was like all
one whole complete thing. And I think -- what Duke was really thinking about, he wasn't thinking about a comparison. He said, "Gee, I've got 10 great saxophone players."
